metadata.title: Guidelines on Control Objectives and Procedures for Outsourced Service Providers (OSPAR Guidelines) - Full Profile (all controls)

party.name: The Association of Banks in Singapore

remarks.p: Unofficial. Imports every control in the unofficial OSCAL catalog of the ABS OSPAR Guidelines v2.0 without selection or modification. ABS publishes no baselines; this profile is a mechanical import target, not a tailoring. The source PDF is authoritative.
